name: Operating-company profile with scam-infrastructure spending and no business footprint
description: A corporate customer in recruitment, customer-service outsourcing, gaming, crypto or consultancy, often with remote principals, shows spending on bulk telecoms, servers, hosting, domains, devices and accommodation but little revenue, payroll or customer activity consistent with its stated business.
fp: Legitimate offshore call centres, start-ups, IT outsourcers and marketing firms also spend heavily on infrastructure and may have thin early-stage revenue and remote ownership.

links.name: Operating-company profile with scam-infrastructure spending and no business footprint
links.ctx: Front or service companies that fund the physical and technical operation of a compound appear as customers whose spending profile fits infrastructure rather than their declared business.
